label: implementation-production-composition-01

status_vocabulary.PROVEN_OFFLINE: the production path of this package was really executed in this process and the named obligation is observable in its artefacts
status_vocabulary.PROVEN_NEGATIVE_OFFLINE: the production path refused the named deviation before or during the run and the refusal is observable
status_vocabulary.NOT_PROVEN: the obligation needs a real native, product or human fact that this package does not have and does not fabricate
status_vocabulary.PRIOR_EVIDENCE_UNCHANGED: the accepted earlier evidence of the exact source is retained; this package neither re-ran nor weakened it

acceptance_map.claim: a missing, foreign or tampered context, hash, root, candidate, authorization or projection is refused in the precheck, before any spawn, with no model action and no business artefact of the run
acceptance_map.gap: the real native admission of the target platform is not proven and is not fabricated

acceptance_map.claim: one context drives the formal worker entry, the real quality phase, the sixteen rows with their source digest and ordinal, the protocol events, the real canonical receipt on disk and the consumption of that receipt by the formal controller
acceptance_map.gap: the native dependency closure, the real worker process and the real media of the product are not proven

acceptance_map.claim: the parent accepts the real row and history order of the phase, the deadline of a row is fixed at its first announcement and a repeated late announcement is refused without extending any deadline
acceptance_map.gap: the real full duration run, the real child lifetime and the platform deadlines of the native run remain unproven

acceptance_map.claim: a refused worker, a changed canonical receipt, a missing canonical receipt and a terminal reference outside the root never produce a successful summary; the root and the reservation are retained, nothing is refunded, nothing is resent and nothing is archived
acceptance_map.gap: the real native cleanup failure of the product owner is not proven

acceptance_map.claim: the controller really calls the parent manifest and consumes its re-check; a replaced root and a missing original are refused instead of being read
acceptance_map.gap: the Windows reparse and junction boundary of the safe read remains an accepted platform gap

acceptance_map.claim: the receipts of this run are adapted from the real canonical receipt, the real source plan and the real manifest into the real twelve key aggregation; the missing independent score, the real A06 isolation, the WebP format receipt, the product cleanup and the installation rollback stay unproven; an old phase fact never fills a green key
acceptance_map.gap: no independent quality score, no real A06 isolation, no WebP product receipt, no installation and no rollback exist for this platform

acceptance_map.claim: the context, the projection, the plan, the canonical receipt, the source plan, the raw artefacts, the parent manifest and the summary are one source chain, and a receipt of another run is refused
acceptance_map.gap: the native descendant custody and the GPU release of the product owner are not proven

acceptance_map.claim: the hard guard is installed before the candidate import and blocks the host process, the socket, the fork, the exec, the system call and the database; no attempt was made during the run; the cleanup of the temporary test root is not the cleanup of the product service
acceptance_map.gap: this boundary is the boundary of this offline package only; it is not a permission for a native platform run and not an A06 proof

acceptance_map.claim: the native admission really uses the accepted budget authority through the accepted loader, the accepted validator and the accepted identity checks; the original ledger is never opened by the controller, the debit stays with the original authority, and the installation and the rollback are required and are missing
acceptance_map.gap: the real first default profile binding, the real warm close, the target platform S2 default integration and the real installation baseline are unproven

acceptance_map.claim: the production residue accessor of the phase is the one that is used; an empty residue is proven empty, an unknown residue keeps its own error and is never read as an empty one, and nothing is deleted by the controller
acceptance_map.gap: the real native residue of the target platform and the Windows junction and reparse boundary remain unproven

acceptance_map.claim: the recovery of an unknown outcome coordinates the existing evidence only: no replay, no resend, no refund, no archive, and no process is selected by a PID that was read from a file
acceptance_map.gap: the real crash of a real parent and the persistent ownership of a real child are unproven

acceptance_map.claim: every one of the twenty four fixed obligations is mapped below to the scope that this package really covers and to the gap that is still open; none of the twenty four is signed and no new denominator is created
acceptance_map.gap: the twenty four obligations keep their own product status; this package signs none of them
